summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K containing its updated Articles of Association, primarily reflecting routine corporate governance and share capital authorizations. The filing does not announce any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is a standard obligation of a foreign private issuer listing the company's name, registered office, objects, share capital, and warrant authorizations without any transactional or extraordinary corporate action. As such, this filing is not a special situation.
